d: A dispute over bursting firecrackers during Diwali in Uttar Pradesh’s Baghpat allegedly escalated into a shooting, leaving President’s Bodyguard Saurabh Tomar seriously injured. On November 13, police arrested the two accused brothers, Dheeraj and Monu, after an encounter in a sugarcane field. According to police, Dheeraj opened fire at the team and was shot in the leg during retaliatory firing. What led to the confrontation, and how did the police track down the accused?
